title: Biggest single line
statementMd:
Which order line has the highest value (quantity times unit price)? Show order id, product id and value.

Expected columns: `order_id`, `product_id`, `value`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Sort by the computed value, take one.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS value FROM order_items oi ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
